scope: UI references and attributable profile image collection only. UI, canonical account data and AI-origin status are not modified.

reference_sources.method: crwl crawl -o markdown-fit plus scrapy profile HTML

observed_ui.portrait: The directory states it displays public profile images; the Ming San detail image alt says Ming San profile portrait. Yang Mun detail portrait is explicitly illustrative and is excluded from assets.
observed_ui.grid: HTML uses ih-grid with repeated mkt-card is-link ih-card anchor cards; the Ming San card contains its named portrait.
observed_ui.search: No search or input field is present in the fetched directory HTML; only a dismiss button is found.
observed_ui.filter: Niches are presented as metadata; active niche filtering is not verified.
observed_ui.density: Name, @handle, niche, followers, a short description and View profile repeat per account.
observed_ui.detail: /ai-influencers/<slug> pages include profile portrait and account-specific information.

copy_mechanism: Use identity-first cards with a clear audience number, platform and details action.
Avoid its unverified revenue promises and automatic AI classification.
limits: The vendor advertises directory size and revenue/production claims; these are not independently measured success evidence.
Its illustrative portrait or unconfirmed original images are not substituted for first-party account images.

research_limits: No independently measured conversion/usability results are obtained for these reference directories. Use these as observed UI patterns, not proof of business success.
Mobbin public category listings are available even though tool/plugin discovery returned no installed Mobbin connector.
No new billing, topup, signup, auth change, message or publication is performed.
